''"Copy that, 1138.|Another stormtrooper and 1138|{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''|date=January 25, 2018}}}} '''1138''' was a [[human]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] who served in the [[First Order military|military forces]] of the [[First Order]] [[Standard decade|decades]] after the [[Galactic Civil War]]. The trooper and members of the [[FN Trooper Corps]] participated in the [[Attack on Tuanul|attack]] on [[Tuanul]], a [[Sacred Villages|village]] located on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]]. After the attack, 1138 checked areas of the village with a fellow stormtrooper and ordered their colleague to fan out during the search, to which the second complied. ==Behind the scenes== [[StarWars.com]] revealed the trooper's identification number and their inclusion in the [[attack on Tuanul]] in its article "From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''". According to the article, 1138 and their fellow stormtrooper were voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]] and [[Sam Witwer]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], although it is unknown which actor voiced which trooper. However, the dialogue cannot be heard in the actual film. ==Appearances== *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''}} {{1stID|1138}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=1138 (Primera Orden) |ja=1138（ファースト・オーダー） }} [[Category:First Order stormtroopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
